page.layout: One page of text. A centred heading at the top. Below it, two parallel columns of names, one left and one right, set in six year groups with rules between them. The years stand in the left margin beside the groups. A catchword sits at the lower right.
page.notes: The page number "10" at the top left and the small marks near the top are handwritten-looking; the page number is read as printed but is doubtful. The year numbers in the left margin and the names are set in italic type. "Horneken." (1600, left) is doubtful: the final flourish is hard to read. The years are notes in the left margin, placed beside their groups. The 1596 year stands beside the heading, which has no names under it. "Joachimus", "Joannes", "Jodocus" and "Joan." are written with J as consonant I. The catchword "Bern-" is at the lower right.
